baslik: Why Six Inches of Water Can Kill You
aciklama:
Floodwater looks harmless but has more force than most people imagine. Here is why it is so deadly.

#shorts #science #flood #safety #nature

sahneler.metin: Just 6 inches of moving water can knock an adult off their feet.
Two feet of it can lift a car and carry it away.
Even a heavy truck floats once buoyancy takes over.
And you cannot see what is hidden under the surface.
The road might be gone, hiding a deadly drop.
The water rises far faster than people expect.
More than half of flood deaths happen inside vehicles.
The rule is simple: turn around, don't drown.

vaka.yanilgi: Floodwater's danger isn't depth alone — moving water pushes with enormous force, and buoyancy lifts cars.
vaka.tartisma: Should flooded roads be physically barricaded instead of just signed?
